title: Addition: On Newton's Attraction and the Celestial Matter
publication: Discours de la cause de la pesanteur
author: Christiaan Huygens
full_title: Discours de la cause de la pesanteur, in Traité de la lumière. Où sont expliquées les causes de ce qui luy arrive dans la reflexion, & dans la refraction. Et particulierement dans l'etrange refraction du cristal d'Islande. Avec un Discours de la cause de la pesanteur
source: An extract from the *Addition* to Huygens's *Discours de la cause de la pesanteur* (Leiden: Pierre vander Aa, 1690), written after he had read Newton's *Principia* (1687).
transcribed_from: the [page images](https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_X9PKaZlChggC) of a copy digitised by Google Books, on the Internet Archive.
summary: Huygens rejects Newton's mutual attraction of all particles of matter, whose cause no principle of mechanics can explain, but accepts the inverse-square centripetal force towards the Sun, which the laws of motion can explain and which makes Newton's system very probable. He argues against an almost empty heaven, and ends by refusing gravity as an inherent quality of matter.
